description: Ministry of Industry and Commerce/ Ministry of Public Administration, Local Government and Democratic Governance - Authorizing the purpose of Sri Saddhananda Daham Pasal Adi Shishya Sangamaya as a purpose to which powers and facilities of the Societies Ordinance - Amendment to the Sri Lanka Scientific Service Minute Notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1925/59 of 29.07.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (a legal statute) to authorize a society's purpose and grant it an exemption from a specific legal provision (Section 5(4)). The content is primarily about applying and modifying a legal/regulatory framework, which fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. Although a minister is named, the notification does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or constitute a government personnel change; the minister is simply acting in his capacity to issue a legal notice.
